issue_discussion_sources: Reddit Tauri updater/signing discussions found through search results
issue_discussion_notes: Community posts were used only as risk signals that updater signing, entitlements, and environment variable handling are common failure points.
community_signal_notes: The implementation adds explicit env validation and generated config files because silent updater-signing misconfiguration is a plausible release risk.

language_options.notes: Best for runtime check/install commands but not enough for packaging/notarization orchestration.
Useful for a future in-app update button but adds frontend dependency and permissions before the release artifact path exists.

language_options.option: Rust Tauri plugin plus Node release scripts
language_options.notes: Matches existing desktop pipeline and keeps secrets in environment during packaging.

selected_language: Rust Tauri plugin plus Node release scripts
language_decision_notes: Rust initializes the official updater plugin in the app; Node scripts already own desktop build orchestration and are the right place for env validation, config generation, and manifest generation.

architecture_options.option: Put updater config directly in base tauri.conf.json
architecture_options.reason: Would force public endpoints/keys into every internal build and risks false public-readiness signals.

architecture_options.option: Generate public Tauri config only in package:public
architecture_options.reason: Keeps internal builds stable and makes public credentials explicit release gates.

architecture_tradeoff_notes: Generated config adds script complexity, but it avoids storing public-release-only settings in the internal config and makes secret boundaries auditable.
code_reference_notes: Followed existing pipeline step definitions, JSON report scripts, and Tauri builder plugin initialization style.

folder_structure_options.reason: Existing desktop scripts are flat and readiness required files currently point to flat script paths.
Matches existing package scripts and keeps pipeline helpers close to release readiness checks.

folder_structure_decision_notes: Generated files go under src-tauri/target/public-release so they are not durable repository artifacts.
folder_semantics_notes: scripts/ owns deterministic build/check automation; specs/docs own durable process and requirements.
maintainability_notes: Public env validation is centralized in public-release-config.mjs and reused by preflight/build/manifest code.
